summary: The Unified School District of De Pere urges the Commission to reject any proposal that would terminate or limit the E-Rate Program. Specifically, they recommend maintaining and protecting the E-Rate Program. The loss of E-Rate funding would require the District to shift resources from other critical programs to pay for the full cost of reimbursement-eligible items, which would not be possible due to state school funding caps.
